name: Biddrina
body:
Biddrina CR
12

The coils of this great serpentlike creature glitter fascinatingly in many different colors, as well as its large, strangely attracting eyes.

XP 19,200
N Huge dragon
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +23

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 11, flat-footed 24 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +16 natural, -2 size)
hp 161 (14d12+70)
Fort +14, Ref +13, Will +15
Defensive Abilities scintillating armor; DR 5/magic; Resist acid 5, electricity 5, fire 5; Immune blindness, dazzled; SR 25

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee bite +21 (2d8+13/19-20 plus grab), tail slap +16 (2d8+13/19-20)
Space 15 ft., Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks constrict (2d8+13), fast swallow, grab, hypnotic gaze (DC 21), swallow whole (1d6+5 acid damage, AC 18, 16 hp)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 14th; concentration +18)

At will—flare burst (DC 15)

STATISTICS

Str 29, Dex 15, Con 20, Int 2, Wis 23, Cha 18
Base Atk +14; CMB +25 (+29 with grapple); CMD 37 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Alertness, Dodge, Improved Critical (bite, tail slap), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack
Skills Perception +23, Swim +2.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Hypnotic Gaze (Su)

A biddrina’s gaze fascinates its victims, leading them to the dragon’s lair to be devoured. A creature that fails the save is affected as by the rainbow pattern spell, following the biddrina’s eyes as it moves.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

Scintillating Armor (Su)

A biddrina’s rainbow scales shed light as a torch and have a 25% chance of negating critical hits or sneak attacks, as light fortification armor.

Swallow Whole (Ex)

A biddrina can expand its jaws to swallow creatures up to Huge size.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests, swamps, and fresh water
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

The biddrina is a predator that inhabits lowland marshes.

This massive serpentine creature is armored in thick blue-green scales and with glowing red eyes and a massive head split wide to reveal rows of sharp teeth. It prowls the wetlands and adjacent areas, concealing itself in water or tall grass as it can, hunting for prey. It will often target settled areas near its lair, preferring the ease of herd animals and humanoids found in one place than hunting wild game.

Adventurers sometimes brave a biddrina’s territory to hunt and slay the beast. The scales and hide of the creature are prized as components in construction of magical armor.
